verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents its own natural-language operation in two ways. Its official MCP server lets users interact with their account from Claude, ChatGPT and Codex to explore setup, diagnose tickets, audit knowledge bases, test tools and build, edit and deploy workflows. Coach is a conversational assistant reachable in Slack, Claude or ChatGPT that can implement improvements on the user's behalf. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these natural-language commands work reliably, and documentation of how far natural-language control extends beyond workflows, simulations and diagnostics (for example account settings and administration).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Lorikeet MCP server lets you interact with your Lorikeet account directly from Claude Code, Claude.ai, ChatGPT, and Codex.
Build, edit, and deploy workflows using natural language
Talk to Coach wherever you work, whether in Lorikeet, Slack, Claude, ChatGPT, or via MCP.
Coach can implement improvements on your behalf, or make suggestions for you to action yourself.
Explore your setup - inspect workflows, tools, and integrations
